backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ICP backend implementing user profiles, comment lists, app events, chat messages, images, settings, and access control using mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the 'Earnings' tab was removed from main navigation in App.tsx and merged into the Live Checker view in LiveChecker.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark mode CSS custom properties (OKLCH color tokens) for the shadcn-ui design system.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'App Content & Feedback Manager' that mounts the React app at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component providing a four-tab navigation shell (User View, Upload, Live Checker, Admin) with a countdown-to-midnight timer, animated background, and app header.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin unlock screen component that prompts for a passcode, auto-skips if localStorage already has valid admin credentials, and calls the useAdminAuth hook to authenticate.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: Bulk Comment Generator component that validates an access key, selects a comment list, and generates multiple comments client-side using useCommentGenerator with quantity capped to available templates.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: Renders an SVG donut chart showing the percentage of used templates out of total templates, with a gradient arc and centered percentage text.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: Implements a canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input, shoots bullets by clicking, and avoids enemies that spawn from the edges.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: Provides a form UI for submitting a text comment via the `useAddChatMessage` mutation hook, displaying loading, success, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Manages admin authentication state with a hardcoded PIN code, persisting unlock status to localStorage and exposing unlock/lock functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Controls background audio playback for a given URL, supporting enable/disable toggling and exposing play/pause controls with playing state.
frontend/src/hooks/useClaimedComments.ts: Persists and retrieves per-device claimed comment records in localStorage, keyed by device ID and list ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides functions to randomly generate single or bulk comments from a `CommentList` by picking random templates and optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second via an interval.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: Generates and persists a unique device UUID in localStorage, returning it as a stable string on every render.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using `@dfinity/auth-client`, exposing identity, login/clear functions, and login status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including comment lists, events, chat, images, settings, earnings, and payouts, with admin code enforcement for mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind, imports Google Fonts, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for a dark neon theme, and provides utility classes like glass-card, gradient-heading, and neon-text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/liveListParser.ts: Parses a structured text report of app entries (with asterisk-wrapped app names and numbered usernames) into typed ParsedAppEntry objects, returning success/error results.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Generates randomized app review comment templates by combining tone-specific adjectives and phrase banks across categories (performance, UI, features, support) with variable lengths.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence and hash cleanup helpers.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: An admin panel for generating comment templates locally based on a topic, tone, count, and optional appended symbol, then selectively adding chosen templates to a target comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: An admin chat panel that displays timestamped messages fetched from the backend (auto-refreshing every 5 seconds) and allows admins to send new messages.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: An admin panel for managing comment lists, supporting create, rename, delete, lock/unlock, and adding templates to lists, with a metrics donut chart view.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminDangerZone: Admin panel section for destructive bulk-delete operations (live lists and comment lists), protected by a modal that requires an access key before confirming deletion.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminEarnings.t: Displays a read-only earnings summary dashboard with per-app breakdown table, pulling data from calculated earnings and app events queries with a manual refresh button.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminEarningsMa: Admin form for adding or editing per-user earnings records, with an editable list that populates the form on row click and persists changes via the addOrUpdateEarning mutation.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin image upload interface that accepts a file, name, and comma-separated tags, shows an upload progress bar, and displays the existing image library with delete and tag indicators.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin panel for managing live-list app events: supports creating/deleting events, bulk-adding usernames, and auto-importing parsed live-list reports with a summary of results.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPayoutRequ: Admin view for listing and approving payout requests, showing pending/approved counts and a table with per-request approve actions, auto-refreshing every 5 seconds.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPricing.ts: Admin view for managing app price entries, supporting add, edit, delete, and bulk CSV-style upload of pricing data.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin view for managing the access key (view, set, regenerate) and background music settings (toggle and file upload).
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel component that gates access behind Internet Identity login and an admin unlock step, then renders tabbed sub-views for comments, live list, pricing, earnings, payouts, danger zone, and settings.
frontend/src/views/EarningsChecker.tsx: Multi-step UI component that lets users look up their earnings by username and submit a payout request with a validated phone number.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: A tabbed UI component that allows users to check if one or multiple usernames appear in app event lists, displaying results with position and earnings data. Includes a single username checker, bulk username checker, and an EarningsChecker tab.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: An upload page that provides three sections: uploading individual comments via UploadComment, generating bulk comments via BulkCommentGenerator, and uploading comment templates from a text file or images to the backend.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: A user-facing view where visitors select a comment list, claim a unique comment (persisted in localStorage to prevent duplicate claims), and copy it to clipboard. Also embeds a TopDownShooter game component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking existing features, pending fix requests (admin authorization error and earnings tab merge), and architectural notes for the live list app.
